{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Shield]] which grants temporary health.}}

{{Status infobox
|Protection
|Protected targets temporarily take reduced DMG. The number represents the degree of reduction. When there are multiple effects of the same type, only the most powerful applies.
|image = [[File: Protect icon.png]]
|type = Buff
|source = Operator
}}

{{Icon|Protect icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Protection]] or '''Protect''' is a type of buff applied to operators in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator in the team casts a Combat Skill that grants Protection, all target operators temporarily take reduced{{Note|While assumed to be an oversight, {{Icon|Purrchena icon|text=false}} [[Purrchena]]'s Battle Skill {{Color|I'M NOT SLEEPING!|7}} can reduce the amount of Protection granted up to {{Color|-10%|1d}} thereby instead increasing the amount of damage taken by the operator.}} damage for a set duration. Some Combat Skills grant Protection only to the caster while others grant Protection to the caster and all operators near the caster. When an operator takes incoming damage, the value is decreased by the number or degree of reduction known as the '''Protection Multiplier'''.

Multiple sources of '''Protection''' <u>do not stack</u> and only the highest Protection Multiplier is used. The resulting Protection Multiplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
